# Third-party TinyMCE components

The files under `vendor/tinymce/` are selected components from
Advanced Editor Tools (previously TinyMCE Advanced) version 5.10.1.

- Source: https://wordpress.org/plugins/tinymce-advanced/
- Copyright: Automattic, Inc. and contributors
- License: GNU General Public License version 2 or later

Only the TinyMCE components required by the WU Toolbox Modular advanced
editor feature are included. The original standalone plugin settings,
menus, update routines, translations, promotional UI, and block-editor
integration are not bundled.
